fee_classes: limit entry maker; stop, wick-close target and 7-day exit taker
monday: America/New_York Monday 00:00 to Tuesday 00:00, 5m extremes (Pine V1.0)
touch: wick reaches the weekly 1.618 inside [Tue 00:00 NY, next Mon 00:00 NY); body strictly on the near side
entry: resting limit at the level after the third wick-touch close; expires at week end
stop: four touch candles' extreme minus/plus stop_buffer_usd, set at the fill candle close
target: opposite 1.618 of the entry week, then the next week once its Monday completes; exit at the close of the first later 12H wick-only reach
control: same NY week and side, random 5m submission close with the same 14-bar 5m TR quarter-octave bucket; signal geometry scaled by close ratio; identical rules
